description:
An issue implementation with proof flow enabled can declare a fresh three-Node snapshot replacement before construction, prove and review it, and install a verified clean generation without first deleting the current promoted snapshot.

## Scope

* In: declared cold replacement construction through the existing constructor, issue-bound evidence, replacement evaluation, transactional generation installation, recovery, and snapshot guidance.
* Out: production sample redesign, generic scenario authority, disaster-recovery rebuild semantics, extra shared Nodes, product changes, and workload migration.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A declaration made before construction selects the standard Gateway, app-dev, and app-prod recipe from the recorded generic base and exact candidate, with no copied records, source, or runtime from the promoted generation. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Unit/E2E/ColdTopologyConstructorTest.php` and Incus harness acceptance `cold-replacement-construction`.
- [ ] The replacement uses native AppInstance and Route sample creation and records normal issue acceptance, complete input evidence, and exact three-Node inventory; an ordinary completed scenario or disaster-recovery rebuild cannot be reclassified as that proof. Proof: harness replacement-command tests and Incus harness acceptance `cold-replacement-proof`.
- [ ] Successful replacement evidence is captured before interactive review; reviewer-modified state is never installed as the shared snapshot, and closeout constructs and verifies clean replacement state from the accepted merged source and recorded inputs when needed. Proof: Incus harness acceptance `cold-replacement-review-isolation`.
- [ ] Before candidate acceptance and verified merge, the promoted generation remains unchanged; failed construction, verification, or installation retains the prior usable generation or explicit recovery state without a success claim. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Feature/Commands/TopologySnapshotCommandsTest.php` and Incus harness acceptance `cold-replacement-rollback`.
- [ ] Successful installation leaves one stopped three-Node shared generation; subsequent ordinary discovery and proof acquire from that generation and observe native AppInstance samples. Proof: Incus harness acceptance `cold-replacement-reacquire`.
- [ ] Cleanup after successful installation or explicit abandonment verifies and removes only the recorded replacement and replaced-snapshot resources, retaining original proof and review records. Proof: Incus harness acceptance `cold-replacement-cleanup`.
- [ ] Maintained snapshot guidance distinguishes declared replacement from scenarios, ordinary refresh, and disaster recovery, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Harness checks pass. Proof: `cd apps/e2e && composer check`.
title: Prove and install an explicitly declared cold snapshot replacement
